Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
759 PM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 2 AM EDT MONDAY THROUGH
MONDAY AFTERNOON...

.TONIGHT...NE winds 10 kt with gusts to 20 kt... becoming NW with
gusts to 20 kt late. Waves 1 to 2 ft. A slight chance of tstms.
Showers. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.MON...N winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt... becoming NW 10 kt
late. Waves 2 to 3 ft. Showers. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 to 3 NM. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.TUE NIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED NIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...N winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming E 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft.
A chance of showers after midnight. 
.FRI...S winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming SW 15 to 20 kt in the
afternoon, then becoming W 25 to 30 kt. Waves 2 to 3 ft...building
to 4 ft. A chance of showers.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
